import numpy as np

for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    grid[2+i]=[int(x) for x in r.split()]
# find seed
seeds=list(zip(*np.where((grid==3))))
# interior
ints=[(r,c) for r in range(15) for c in range(15) if grid[r,c]==0 and 2<r<11 and 2<c<12 and grid[r-1,c] or False]
# simpler: interior = zeros within bounding box of 3s
rs,cs=np.where(grid==3)
r0,r1,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(),cs.max()
seed=None
for r in range(r0,r1+1):
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if grid[r,c]==3 and 0<r<r1 and c0<c<c1: seed=(r,c)
print(seed, r0,r1,c0,c1)
out=grid.copy()
for r in range(r0+1,r1):
    for c in range(c0+1,c1):
        d=max(abs(r-seed[0]),abs(c-seed[1]))
        out[r,c]=3 if d==0 else (4 if d%2==1 else 2)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
